newsitem.title: USA: ChiRex's Bratzler resigns as CEO, chairman.
newsitem.headline: ChiRex's Bratzler resigns as CEO, chairman.

text.p: ChiRex Inc said on Thursday Dr. Robert Bratzler had resigned as chairman and chief executive to pursue personal interests.
The company said in a statement that Alan R. Clark, formerly chief operating officer, has been named chairman, chief executive and president, effective immediately.

"I have decided that this is a window of opportunity to step down and to transfer all my full-time management responsibilities to Alan's capable hands so that I can refocus my energies on other business interests," Bratzler said in the statement.
He will continue to serve on the ChiRex board of directors and consult on the further development of the company's chemistry technologies and its relationships with the Scientific Advisory Board.
